newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.

text.p: The State Bank of Pakistan said on Saturday it had invited bids up to Monday for the auction of six-month maturity short-term federal bonds.
It said the result of the auction would be announced on Tuesday with settlement set for Thursday.
A pre-auction target has been set at six billion rupees but bids can be rejected without giving any reason, it said.

In the previous auction held on December 3, bids worth 3.277 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 15.91331 percent per annum, against a pre-auction target of four billion rupees.
